latest.title: First release
highlights: Slash tyres, cut brake lines and sugar the tank, with a fuel line and a car bomb as options.
Every job takes time and skill checks, and the damage plays out gradually: tyres go down, brake fluid leaks, engines wear out.
Inspect, patch with duct tape, repair with a line repair kit, and defuse; every action checked by the server and logged with /tamperlog.
Qbox, QBCore, ESX or standalone, most inventories, targets and fuel resources, in 15 languages.
